name: Tamale
registryBasis: The national Lands Commission lists a Client Service Access Unit in Tamale, and its Survey and Mapping Division states that it holds parcel-survey records and prepares/certifies survey plans for land registration. These establish a local service presence and national survey/cadastre functions, but not a publicly downloadable Tamale parcel layer.

portals.name: Lands Commission Client Service Access Unit (Tamale) and national Survey and Mapping Division; reviewed service information rather than an interactive parcel viewer.
portals.operator: Official local, regional or national agency as identified in the source pages
portals.observation: Official CSAU page lists Tamale among Lands Commission client-service locations and describes application workflows; some stated requirements include personal/client information, which was not submitted.

requests.observation: Official CSAU page lists Tamale among Lands Commission client-service locations and describes application workflows; some stated requirements include personal/client information, which was not submitted.
Official Survey and Mapping Division page describes custody of parcel survey records, plan preparation, mapping and certification as institutional duties.

Official 2025 RTI manual identifies the regional office structure and Northern Region office in Tamale. No map schema, anonymous vector download or safe feature endpoint appears in the reviewed material.
Official fee schedule lists paid survey/map services; this is a service route, not open parcel geometry.

limitations: The identified parcel-plan and survey-data services require formal applications and/or licensed-surveyor inputs. No anonymous geometry+stable-ID schema or public city parcel dataset was verified; no property or client query was made.
scopeLimits: No protected or personal/property-specific information queried; no anonymous full geometry and stable-ID allowlist verified. No completeness claim.
